Class LlamaOpenApiProperties

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.llm.LlamaOpenApiProperties
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix="spring.ai.llama-openapi") public class LlamaOpenApiProperties extends Object
The LlamaOpenApiProperties class binds spring.ai.llama-openapi. There is no Spring AI starter for this prefix. The default base URL is http://127.0.0.1:3333. The default API key is blank. The default alias is blank. The default num-ctx is 4096. temperature and num-predict stay null when those yaml keys are absent.
